Project Mandela 1.0.0

Released 2026-10-13 · GitHub release · CHANGELOG.md

1.0.0 — 2026-10-13

Added

  • The whole tool chain, in one commit (2026-10-10, 20597a07, #325): lexer, recursive-descent parser, AST, bytecode compiler and stack VM, the capability-gated runtime and its standard library (the std.fs, std.json, std.math and std.time modules, plus the text, list and map members every value answers to), the JSR-223 ScriptEngine, the embedding API (Mandela, Runtime, Capabilities, Interop), and the mandela CLI with its REPL — no third-party dependency and no lg3d-core import, which is what lets the same jar answer in a headless test, inside a tool's JVM and inside a browser page.
  • scripts/mandela/, the repository's automation written in the language it ships (2026-10-10, db722813, #326): doc-links.mnd, release-check.mnd, startmenu-audit.mnd, asset-report.mnd and the userscript-new.mnd generator, aggregated as :lg3d-mandela:repositoryChecks.
  • html-links.mnd (2026-10-11, 8e646a03, #334) — the gate for the Pages documentation site: every href/src resolves, every viewer.html?path= names a document that exists, every Mermaid fence is balanced. The language auditing the site that documents it.
  • The module's own guides (2026-10-11, 14a1d125, #336): ARCHITECTURE.md, DEVELOPMENT.md and FUNCTIONAL_ANALYSIS.md — the numbered requirements (FR1–FR9) the language promises against.
  • Cucumber BDD over the real surfaces (2026-10-11, e4676f40): the .feature file is a second, executable statement of the language guide, and it runs inside the module's test task.
  • values covered from both sides (2026-10-11, ac5d8cac, bb85aa99): the operator table answered row by row, from a script and from the host.
  • Tests that address the machine in its own instruction set (2026-10-12, 681e2917): a bytecode script is disassembled back to the mnemonics the shipped disassembler prints, so a test names opcodes instead of imitating them.
  • i18n-keys.mnd (2026-10-12, 00b8740f), legacy-j3d.mnd and scripts-hygiene.mnd (2026-10-12, 9aa99ca3) — the shell-bundle contract, the Java 3D migration rule and the automation's own wiring, each as a gate.
  • whats-new.mnd (2026-10-12, 4d1f7366): the language generates a page of the desktop's own Help Center from CHANGELOG.md and fails the build when the shipped topic goes stale.
  • docs/HISTORY.md (2026-10-12, cdd566a0) — why the name, who made it, and the milestone record — and docs/USAGE.md (2026-10-12, 322e9dd2), the language at work with real transcripts of the scripts.
  • The second render target (2026-10-13, 3ed4fd5e, #378): whats-new.mnd now also draws one page per released version under documentation/releases/, with the archive index and the portal card, so the changelog feeds the dialog, the help topic and the site from one source.
  • Mandela's own version identity (this release): mandela.version and mandela.language in gradle.properties name the jar and the language independently of the desktop, the jar manifest carries both, and mandela-version.mnd gates the eight places they are written.
  • Str.indexOf / List.indexOf honour a start index (2026-10-12, 589182b1, #354).

Changed

  • Three retirements, each found by asking what can reach it (2026-10-11 → 12, 440bfab3, 7f6ab09f, 1401efdf): the AST node no syntax can produce, the value surface no receiver can reach, and the five opcodes no compiler can emit.
  • The interpreter's limits (padStart, padEnd, text.repeat) honour the same text ceiling as everything else (2026-10-12, 9aa99ca3).

Fixed

  • An overflowing Int promotes instead of losing its operand (2026-10-11, a0375296).
  • A closure capture is handed to the function that asks for it (2026-10-11, d108a371).
  • A host function's answer is converted at the machine (2026-10-11, 001a1cfc).
  • The json module is as strict as it claims to be (2026-10-11, 65f98143).
  • The standard library's edge cases answer as the guide promises (2026-10-11, 2f404507).
  • A range counts along its stride, and values compare all the way down (2026-10-11, 7b033c71).
  • The VM tells the truth about the arities it refuses (2026-10-12, f8054454).
  • release-check.mnd tolerates the release-cut and the bare [Unreleased] header shapes (2026-10-11, 883bf5a4, c1c1e8bf).

The test reports of a published release are generated beside this page: <version>/reports/ carries the JUnit, JaCoCo, Cucumber and PIT mutation reports of every module with a test suite. Each module runs report-only (mutationThreshold = 0, no gate) unless it appears in the mutationExemptions map, where it is gated at the score its own suite really achieves. The same tree is attached to the GitHub release as reports-<version>.zip, so a report outlives a rebuilt site.
